import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
H = {'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 \(Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64\) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'}

sites = [
    \('Vroom.be',    'https://www.vroom.be/fr/voitures-occasion'\),
    \('Cardoen.be',  'https://www.cardoen.be/fr/voitures-occasion'\),
    \('AutoFacile',  'https://www.autofacile.be/occasion/'\),
    \('Kilometre',   'https://www.kilometre.be/voitures-occasion'\),
    \('TrustDeals',  'https://www.trustdeals.be/voitures-occasion'\),
]

for name, url in sites:
    try:
        r = requests.get\(url, headers=H, timeout=10\)
        soup = BeautifulSoup\(r.text, 'lxml'\)
        title = soup.find\('title'\)
        articles = soup.find_all\('article'\)
        nextdata = soup.find\('script', id='__NEXT_DATA__'\)
        print\(f'{name}: {r.status_code} | articles={len\(articles\)} | next_data={nextdata is not None} | title={title.text[:50] if title else \\"?\\"}'\)
    except Exception as e:
        print\(f'{name}: ERROR {str\(e\)[:60]}'\)
" 2>&1)
